name: Crabel NR4/NR7 narrow-range day breakout
author: Toby Crabel (via StockCharts)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Daily bars (Crabel traded futures; applicable to crypto daily).
entry_long: Identify NR7 (range = high-low is the smallest of last 7 days; NR4 for 4 days). Buy on a move above the narrow-range day high on the following day(s).
entry_short: Sell short on a move below the narrow-range day low.
exit: Crabel took profit at the close of the first trading day or first profitable close. Alternatives: next resistance, percentage target, or trailing stop.
stop_loss: Exit if price trades back through the opposite side of the NR day (low for longs, high for shorts); alternative: 2x ATR trailing or Parabolic SAR.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Time stop at first profitable close/EOD makes this a 1-3 day system.
